methodology.attribution: wall-timed sequential host/guest work; process CPU from getrusage
methodology.traffic: application framing before connection streaming deflate
methodology.count_units: projected_ticks and nav_recomputes have count values despite *_us field labels in raw logs; ignore total_ms on these counters

tcp_sample.scope: localhost compressed TCP stream; recovery included; process memory/CPU not reliable

methodology.manifest: Frozen real 2-participant captures after the original 120-tick warmup; five builds per sample, three repetitions; compare full builder with warmed exact wall reuse. Roots match.
methodology.fallback: Synthetic 5305/50190-wall baseline; 16 successful fallback responses including one initial encoding with reuse enabled; three repetitions. Re-encoding baseline clears the reusable correction body before each response. Guest queue drained between repetitions.
methodology.live: Original deterministic audit workload with 2 participants; 120 warmup + 120 measured ticks (6 simulated seconds), three paired repetitions per map. Both binaries have the relay fixes and fallback-body reuse; only wall-manifest reuse differs. Combined process CPU; no rendering or real sockets.
methodology.limits: Short native samples do not certify 16 participants, long-run convergence, browser performance, compressed uplink or fleet CPU/RSS budgets.

negative_controls: owned wall comparison replaced with capture alias: test fails
fresh baseline invalidation omitted: test fails
